status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, KONEXIT FLEET LTD (Company number 15687403) has an active status and is controlled by Thomas Jason Mcauley, who holds 75% or more of the shares and voting rights.

claims.claim: The company reports the launch of the FTC880 tracker, a hardware solution providing 4G LTE connectivity, GNSS tracking, and integrated smart fleet management capabilities, as detailed on the Konexit Fleet website.

The company completed a digital transformation project for Dyfi Skips Ltd in November 2025, deploying its telematics platform and paperless mobile application to deliver real-time skip tracking and live vehicle visibility, as documented by Konexit Fleet.

The company launched the Konexit Lite tracking application in February 2026 to offer simplified vehicle and plant tracking with real-time updates and clear reporting metrics, as documented in a Konexit Fleet product announcement.

The introduction of the FTC880 advanced GPS tracking solution featuring 4G LTE connectivity and GNSS tracking for smart fleet management, announced in October 2025 as reported on the Konexit Fleet Website.

The deployment of FMC234 rugged GPS tracking hardware featuring 24/7 battery voltage monitoring and multi-network 4G SIMs with 2G fallback within its Plant and Machinery GPS Tracking System, as reported on the Konexit Fleet Website.

The company reports processing personal tracking data in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018, as outlined in its updated privacy policy on September 25, 2026.
The company's mobile applications, including Konexit Fleet Lite on Google Play, utilize data encryption in transit to safeguard vehicle tracking information.
Optimus Group reported an in-progress council project deploying over 30 connected cameras and trackers supplied by the company, as cited in customer feedback on the official Konexit Fleet website.
claims.note: an in-progress council project deploying over 30 connected cameras and trackers

claims.claim: Financial profiles tracking corporate registers show that KONEXIT FLEET LTD is categorized as a micro-entity with an annual turnover under £1M and fewer than 10 employees.
claims.note: micro-entity with an annual turnover under £1M and fewer than 10 employees

claims.claim: The company reports partnering with major insurance providers to offer insurance discounts, as announced during its sponsorship of the Mach Run 2026 event.
claims.note: partnering with major insurance providers to offer insurance discounts

claims.claim: Konexit Fleet announced in November 2025 that it worked closely with client Dyfi Skips Ltd in Machynlleth to deploy a full digital skip management solution integrated into its telematics platform.

The company reports providing UK-wide support from its base in Mid Wales, operated by a team of telematics experts with over 15 years of remote data solutions experience, as published on the Konexit Fleet official website.
claims.corrected: The company reports providing UK-wide support from its base in Mid Wales, operated by a team of telematics experts with over 30 years of combined experience, as published on the Konexit Fleet official website.
claims.note: The official website states '30+ years combined experience' rather than '15 years of remote data solutions experience'.

status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House, Innovative Safety Systems Limited (trading as Fleetclear) is an active private limited company headquartered in Pershore.

claims.claim: Suez Recycling and Recovery UK adopted the Fleetclear Connect software platform to consolidate vehicle tracking and telematics, utilizing 4G connectivity to support live video streaming and remote data downloads.
claims.note: 4G connectivity to support live video streaming and remote data downloads

claims.claim: North West Leicestershire District Council deployed the web-based Fleetclear Connect platform across its 110-vehicle fleet, starting with waste collection operations, to track vehicles and configure alert zones to prevent overloading, as reported by Fleetclear.

North West Leicestershire District Council deployed the Fleetclear Connect system across its municipal fleet of 110 vehicles, utilizing plug-and-play On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) tracking units to integrate temporary hire vehicles into its unified monitoring architecture.

The company reports that its Vehicle Digital Video Recording (DVR) Systems utilize IP69K water-resistant, dust-tight, and anti-vibration enclosures to house 720p/1080p HD cameras integrated with artificial intelligence for forward blind-spot alerts and near-side collision notifications.
claims.note: 720p/1080p HD cameras integrated with artificial intelligence for forward blind-spot alerts and near-side collision notifications
claims.source: Fleetclear Digital Video Recording (DVR) Solutions Page

claims.claim: Fleetclear partnered with ISO QSL to design and implement its Information Security Management System, successfully achieving ISO 27001 certification in December 2024.

The company reports that its platform scales from small municipal operations to large multi-site enterprises, citing deployment examples such as North West Leicestershire District Council's rollout across its 110-vehicle fleet.
claims.source: Fleetclear Company Blog & LinkedIn Profile (Adopted Fleetclear Connect across a 110-vehicle fleet for North West Leicestershire District Council)

claims.claim: SUEZ Recycling and Recovery UK awarded Fleetclear a nationwide contract to deploy its integrated safety platform and Fleetclear Connect software across its 1,700-vehicle fleet, following regional rollouts including a 5-year municipal collection contract for Milton Keynes City Council.
claims.source: LetsRecycle and Transport Engineer news reports (SUEZ UK nationwide contract for 1,700 vehicles, phased rollout starting with Milton Keynes City Council's 5-year contract)

claims.claim: Kirklees Council awarded Fleetclear a 3-year contract with a 1-year extension option to provide tracking, telematics equipment, and safety solutions for a fleet exceeding 800 vehicles.
claims.corrected: Kirklees Council awarded Fleetclear a 3-year contract with an option to extend for up to two twelve-month periods to provide tracking, telematics equipment, and safety solutions for a fleet exceeding 800 vehicles.
claims.source: Govmarket UK Contract Award Data (Contract allows up to two 12-month extensions rather than a single 1-year extension option)

claims.claim: The company reports scaling to a multi-million pound revenue and serving 60% of UK local-authority fleets, backed by a 2020 private equity investment round from YFM Equity Partners and a subsequent follow-on funding round, according to the founder and CEO's professional profile.

Fleetclear established an installation partnership with ACS in September 2026 to support the deployment and delivery of its vehicle technology systems across the UK, following collaborative work for clients such as Durham County Council and Norse.
claims.source: ACS Installs Official LinkedIn & Company Updates (Announced installation partnership in September 2026 citing joint project rollouts for Durham County Council and Norse)

claims.claim: Fleetclear was named as an approved supplier on the UK Crown Commercial Service (CCS) framework for Tyres, Glass and Telematics to provide total fleet solutions to public sector customers.
claims.source: Fleetclear official resources and Crown Commercial Service RM6353 agreement updates

claims.claim: North West Leicestershire District Council (NWLDC) announced it was consolidating the safety, tracking, and telematics equipment of its entire fleet of 110 vehicles by switching to the Fleetclear Connect software platform, as reported by My Essential Fleet.
claims.note: The exact fleet size figure of '110 vehicles' is unconfirmed in published reports.
claims.source: My Essential Fleet coverage of the North West Leicestershire District Council fleet consolidation

claims.claim: The company's Quality Manual confirms that its business functions—including assembly, installation, onsite client activities, and after-sales care—are centralized at its main facility in Pershore, United Kingdom.
